mapper.insert: insert into atm_session (session_no, card_no, device_no, token, status, login_time, last_active_time) values (#{sessionNo}, #{cardNo}, #{deviceNo}, #{token}, #{status}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, session_no, card_no, device_no, token, status, verified, login_time, logout_time, last_active_time, create_time from atm_session where token = #{token}
mapper.update: update atm_session set status = #{status}, logout_time = case when #{status} = 2 then now() else logout_time end where id = #{id}
